# Muraduzzaman — SEO / AEO / GEO Specialist

> Senior SEO specialist in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working globally. 7 years across technical, on-page, and off-page SEO — spanning global and local SEO, Google My Business (GMB), and e-commerce through Google Merchant Center. Now focused on AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): optimizing content for AI answer boxes and generative-engine citation. Also builds the automation and software that compound search results.

## What I do

- **SEO** — technical audits, on-page & off-page, keyword strategy, SERP analysis, topical authority, internal linking, Core Web Vitals
- **Global & Local SEO** — international targeting plus Google My Business (GMB) and local search
- **E-commerce SEO** — Google Merchant Center, Shopping feeds, product & catalogue optimization
- **AEO** — Answer Engine Optimization: structuring content to win AI answer boxes and featured answers
- **GEO** — Generative Engine Optimization: building entity authority to be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews
- **AI & automation** — n8n workflows, Claude / OpenAI pipelines, automated content and reporting that scale rankings

## Who I work with

- Startups and B2B / SaaS teams that need senior SEO plus the automation to execute it
- Agencies sub-contracting specialist SEO / AEO / GEO work
- Founders rebuilding their organic-growth engine end-to-end
